items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Firehouse five. ... INTERVIEWEE: Those guys worked. Oh, man, they worked. Pollock. Ben Pollock. Yeah, Ben Pollock. Yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, this is an item. Let's see. I know, but the Lyon Center, where you were talking about the Lyon Center. Oh, yeah.

Oh, yeah. I don't know how to put it. This is from Variety. Hollywood Inside. There's a write-up somewhere on that. It was about third Dixie Jubilee set in Hollywood. Oh, no. Mm-hmm. Third annual Dixieland Jubilee presented. Kiddo Repeat Daily, Ben Pollock, Red Nickels, and Happy Lamar. Mm-hmm. Nappy Lamar. And, uh, Sharky Banana will bring his band to the coast from New Orleans for the event. That was at the time that Red Nickels offered me a job at his band.
